title: Zesty Syrian Millet Pilaf
description: A garlicky, crunchy millet pilaf with caramelized onions, chickpeas, and lemon zest, perfect for kids and vegan-friendly.
instructions: Rinse the millet under cold water until clear.
In a saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add millet and stir to coat with oil, cooking until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, add salt and cumin, bring to a simmer.
Cover the pot, reduce heat to low, and cook for 15 minutes until millet is tender.
Stir in cooked chickpeas, lemon zest, and lemon juice, then remove from heat.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and let it sit, covered, for 5 minutes.
Serve warm, optionally topped with fresh parsley for color.
